messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — I opened a commit proposal for extra GPU capacity and I need finance sign-off by Friday. Goal: cover expected Q3/Q4 serving growth without wild on-demand spikes.

alex: TL;DR numbers below, asking which term we prefer (12mo vs 36mo) and whether to split across regions. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

alex: Proposal (monthly effective cost):
```
Option A - 12mo A100 (us-west2): $46k/mo (saves ~28% vs on-demand)
Option B - 36mo A100 (us-west2): $34k/mo (saves ~45% vs on-demand)
Option C - 12mo H100 (eu-central1): $72k/mo (saves ~22%)
Option D - 36mo H100 (eu-central1): $53k/mo (saves ~40%)
```

maya: Can you attach the utilization forecast that justifies the 36mo? Finance needs peak vs baseline utilization and risk plan for model changes. Also what's the depreciation if we do a mixed commit?

alex: attaching numbers inline: we expect steady traffic growth +20% QoQ; baseline util now ~55% for current A100 pools, projected to hit ~78% by Q4 if product roadmap lands. Mixed commit amortizes like this: commit split 60% A100 us-west2, 40% H100 eu-central1 -> blended cost ~ $41.6k/mo (36mo).

devops-bot: Cost simulation job #452 completed. Summary: blended 36mo commit reduces monthly token-serving cost by ~38% (median). Burst reserve cushion (10%) recommended to avoid throttling during experiments.

sylvia: I like the cost math but worried about lock-in: research team may switch larger models to H100 quickly. If we commit too much A100 we'll be stuck. Can we add a conversion buffer or ability to buy burst H100 on-demand?

liam: Also flag — last month's invoice had a weird cross-region egress charge spike from eu-central->us-west. Finance noticed a ~$28k unexplained line. Recommend we hold final sign-off until billing team reconciles that, otherwise our baseline is off.

finance_ops: We can greenlight a partial commit today but need two conditions: 1) spike protection (auto-burst+fallback) and 2) a quarterly review gate with the ability to pause renewal if utilization drops >15%. If liam's egress anomaly persists in the audit, we'll prefer a shorter term (12mo) or a staged purchase.

alex: Understood. Action plan: 1) eng-infra will open a billing ticket to resolve the egress spike (liam to lead) 2) we push a staged commit PR: 60% 36mo A100 in us-west2 + 40% 12mo H100 in eu-central1 (this gives flexibility) 3) add auto-burst config and a renewal review reminder 30d before term end.

liam: I'll start the billing audit now and post the findings in this thread. ETA EOD Thursday.

maya: If billing looks clean, finance_ops can approve the staged commit. Please put the final amortized numbers and the renewal/kill-switch text into the purchase request.

alex: Thanks everyone — I'll update the PR and tag finance_ops once liam confirms. :thumbsup:
